annotations.text:
OPTION A · Warm editorial
Light, boutique, refined — an elevated take on your current navy + gold + cream. Cormorant serif, arched photo framing.

OPTION B · Heritage
Textured limestone, letterpress feel, symmetric framed layout. Frank Ruhl Libre (Hebrew + Latin), olive + terracotta. Traditional and warm.

OPTION C · Midnight & gold
Dark, luminous, reverent. Marcellus display over a dimmed photo, glowing gold rules. Dramatic and modern-luxe.
